To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the usability of the telepresence system is improved by the enhancement level, the feeling of presence is not improved by the enhancement levels and the feeling of the operator is improved by the use of the system.
the teleoperation/telepresent interfaces are very good for performing tasks that do not require high-level cognitive abilities.

teleoperation and telepresences systems can provide a good solution for remote operation of a robot, and that a cognitive interface can provide a good human robot interface for a robot that can be used in an unstructured environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a cognitive human-robot interface.
the design and evaluation of telepresence interfaces for teleoperation systems as well as the design of a human-robot interface (HRI) for service robots.
the usability aspects of the HRI and teleoperation interfaces
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
teleoperation and telepresent systems are still very useful in certain situations and tasks.
the telepresence and teleoperation systems are more usable than the robot interfaces.
the teleoperation interfaces have a higher usability than the HRIs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cognitive interface is a promising approach to the human robot interface, and that a human service robot should be capable of providing a high degree of cognitive support to the human operator.
telepresence and direct teleoperation are the most promising approaches for the development of the human robot interface.
the cognitive human - robot interface is the most promising approach for a future human robot interface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cognitive human - robot interface is a very promising approach to service robots.
teleoperation and telepresent systems can be very effective and efficient in certain tasks, especially in tasks that involve the use of a robot arm or a vehicle.
the HRI has a crucial role in the development of FSR.
